therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: restore PD-1 inhibitor sensitivity and convert PD-L1 negative to positive
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: PD-1 inhibitor-resistant melanoma and PD-L1 <1% NSCLC patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum Tolerated Dose, Safety, and Progression-free Survival

results.dose_information: IMM60 every 3 weeks for up to 6 cycles IV, Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles IV

context.investigator_commentary: Prioritization of other pipeline assets. No safety or efficacy issues were observed.
